_what_this_is: DERIVED-CACHE cleanup events, deliberately NOT tombstones. A tombstone means a path is permanently retired and asserts that nothing may recreate it; both of these caches are recreated by routine commands (`uv sync`, any Hub download). Filing them as active tombstones would reproduce the tombstone-semantics defect this project has already fixed twice — an active tombstone naming a path a living session legitimately writes.
